result_text:
I removed the `# noqa: C901` and fixed the complexity warning another way, so `_adapter.py` has no new suppression comments. Ruff passes and `tests/test_ag_ui.py` passes (132 tests).

To bring the complexity down, I moved the uploaded-file `ActivityMessage` construction out of `_dump_request_parts` into a module-level helper, `_uploaded_file_activity`. Its behaviour is unchanged. I haven't re-run the Stop hook itself, so I can't confirm it now passes.
